learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge of the fundamentals of electronics.
Demonstrate the ability to analyze and synthesize.
Acquire the ability for effective problem-solving.
Possess knowledge of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT).
Information search and management skill.
Develop critical reasoning.
Develop the ability to work in a team.
Ability to apply knowledge to practice.
Acquire the capacity for autonomous learning and concern for knowledge and continuous training.
Develop the ability to adapt to new situations.
Ability to work autonomously.
Motivation for quality and continuous improvement.
Understand the characteristics, types, and applications of some of the main electronic components and integrated circuits.
Design and analyze basic electronic circuits.
Interpret the technical specifications of electronic components.
Interpret and understand the technical characteristics of cables, connectors, and communication equipment to make an appropriate selection.
Implement electronic circuits in the laboratory.
Use electronic simulation programs for circuit design and analysis.
Know basic electronics instrumentation equipment and main measurement techniques, in order to perform experimental measurements on application circuits.
Preparation of reports related to laboratory practices.
Awareness of the importance of knowing and complying with safety regulations related to laboratory work.

teaching_methods: Individualized or group tutorials at the request of students

assessment_methods.method: Continuous assessment: Partial tests (two tests, 20% each)

assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of a global test (40%), two partial tests (40%), and practices/problems (20%). The global test and partial tests are recoverable in the second call. The grade for practices/problems is not recoverable in the second call. For exceptional evaluation, there is a global test (40%), a theoretical-practical test for units 1, 2, and 3 (20%, multiple choice), a theoretical-practical test for units 4 and 5 (20%), and a practical test (20%), all taken on the day of the first call exam.
